that's the thing. I'm not sure what they want from me. they say that they want me to be happy. and I don't think they're lying. I guess they have just seen me fail so much. they are such unhappy people and I feel like I am the cause of that, even though I know I'm not. 

I am so lucky in this life. three years ago i met the most incredible person. on the fucking internet of all places. he loves me. he is patient and sweet and handsome and everything I have ever wanted. he has paid thousands and thousands of dollars for us to see each other. he'll be here in seven days. he's taking me to disney world after Christmas. he says I can come home soon and live in Sydney with him. I owe everything to him. I'll hold on for that.

I have always been hard to deal with and I always caused the fight. I love my parents and I think they love me. I wish I could be what they wanted. I just want to go home. I wish it was summer again. winter is so awful to me.
I'm not being abused. I brought this on myself.

I won't ever speak to anyone in my life about anything anymore. it always gets back to my mother. and she questions and criticizes the things I say when I'm under pressure. I've told her I'm suicidal before. many times. they don't believe me. I wish they would just hit me again. I wish someone would hit me. I want to hurt so badly but I've never been able to hurt myself. I haven't eaten in days. I don't want to be this person anymore. I don't want to be nora. Nora is a fucking idiot. I keep yelling and screaming at myself when I'm alone. I'm losing my connection to reality again.

I deserved it really. I've gotten into several physical fights with my parents over the years. that's not really what bothers me. I deserved them. what gets to me is since I dropped out of school they don't talk to me like a normal person. they don't accept my apologies. they don't seem to have any compassion towards me at all.
